title: Evidence Results
description: Recorded measurements submitted to `evidence_contract.py evaluate`. Per-variation verdicts are NEVER supplied by the caller; they are derived by the evaluator from these recorded metrics, the contract's typed decision semantics, uncertainty budgets, and combination rule. Structural violations exit nonzero with evaluation_status=invalid.

path.description: Repo-relative path to a regular file. Absolute paths, traversal, directories, and paths resolving outside the repository are rejected.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the file contents.

contract_id.description: Must match the contract being evaluated.

dimensions.description: Exactly one scalar value per declared allowed-variation dimension. Unknown dimensions, undeclared or non-scalar values are structural errors.

artifacts.description: Artifacts required to reproduce this variation's recorded metrics, verified by digest. Missing or mismatched artifacts make this variation indeterminate (or the whole audit Not Auditable under on_missing=not-auditable).

metrics.description: Metric name -> recorded measurement. Names must match the contract's metrics.

value.description: The computed metric value per the contract's metric definition. Must be finite and inside the metric's declared domain.

reference.description: Reference scale for relative-scale support/reversal conditions.

uncertainty_budget.description: Quantitative uncertainty budget. A list of source names alone can never satisfy the contract's uncertainty requirements.

components.description: Source name -> component. Every mandatory source declared by the contract must appear here.

estimate.description: Numeric standard-uncertainty component for this source.

exact.description: Declares this source contributes exactly zero uncertainty (deterministic).

aggregation.description: How components combine into the total (root-sum-square or linear sum). Checked for consistency.

total.description: Total standard uncertainty on `value`. Must be consistent with the declared aggregation of the components.

evidence_missing.description: True when evidence for this variation is missing. Consequence is governed by the contract's missing_evidence_policy.on_missing.

baseline_id.description: Must exactly match a frozen identifier from the contract: the initial_baseline_id, or an escalation rule's expected_baseline_id.

identity.description: Human-readable identity of the classical baseline actually used (method + implementation).

artifacts.description: Digest-verified repo files proving the baseline was executed. This is the only evidence the evaluator labels 'verified'.

citations.description: Literature citations (doi:/arXiv:/citation:). Recorded as citation-present; a citation establishes provenance but never proves the baseline was executed.

matched_inputs.description: True only if the baseline consumed the same instances/inputs as the quantum side.

rule_id.description: Which contract escalation rule this refers to. Required in practice whenever trigger_fired is true.

honored.description: A claim of honoring is accepted only when baseline_id equals the rule's expected_baseline_id AND the baseline artifacts verify by digest.

trigger_evidence.description: Recorded evidence/justification for the trigger assessment (which may involve human judgment against the locked criteria).
